g.text: Tailscale Funnel — entities, data pieces & flow (incl. the node-collision + Funnel checks)
Generate auth key (sign up if new)
A brand-new account has NO nodes → no collision, steps 5-8 never happen.
Only a repeat-installing tester hits them. Enabling Funnel (step 9) is
also a one-time website step the first time.
